more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Curdlan is a high-molecular-weight glucose polymer with beta-1,3 linkages. The specified ingredient is produced by bacterial fermentation with Alcaligenes faecalis var. myxogenes. FDA describes it as a formulation aid, stabiliser, thickener, texturiser or processing aid. These are preparation-specific technological uses of the carbohydrate polymer.
more_info.origin: Produced by pure-culture fermentation using the specified Alcaligenes faecalis var. myxogenes bacterium. The resulting beta-1,3-glucan is a microbial polysaccharide. The organism and preparation specified in the regulation should be distinguished from other glucan sources.
